item.text: I’ll check the order export for Riverside orders dated March 2026.

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import csv
with open(\"data/orders.csv\", newline=\"\") as source:
    orders = {row[\"order_id\"] for row in csv.DictReader(source) if row[\"store\"] == \"Riverside\" and row[\"order_date\"].startswith(\"2026-03-\")}
print(len(orders))
PY"
